municipality-code.title: Municipality code (kommunekode)
municipality-code.note: The same codes are written two ways: DAR and BBR as four characters with leading zeros (`0101`), Danmarks Statistik and its StatBank tables as a number (`101`). Compare them as numbers, or pad to four characters. Codes are reused across the 2007 reform (169 was Høje Tåstrup, is Høje-Taastrup; Frederikssund was 209, is 250): a table from before 2007 needs the codes valid then.

changes.what: Region Hovedstaden (1084) and Region Sjælland (1085) become Region Østdanmark (1086)

postcode.title: Postcode (postnummer)
postcode.note: A postcode is not a municipality: one postcode can cross municipal borders, and Copenhagen and Frederiksberg have many.

region-code.title: Region code (regionskode)
region-code.note: **The regions change on 1 January 2027:** Region Hovedstaden (1084) and Region Sjælland (1085) become Region Østdanmark (1086; CPR). It is the first change to the regions since they were created in 2007, and a simple one: two codes merge into one, so a time series by region maps 1084 and 1085 to 1086 (the code list says which municipality lies in which region now and from 2027). Matriklen keeps the region on its municipalities from model 3.0.0, no longer on each parcel.

changes.what: Region Hovedstaden (1084) and Region Sjælland (1085) become Region Østdanmark (1086)

status_roles.about: What each status code of the basic-data registers means for the question 'did the object exist on a given date?'. One small common vocabulary, so a tool can select 'as it existed on a date' or 'new since a date' in any register. Proposed by hand 2026-11-26; BBR's reviewed 2026-11-27, DAR's and Matriklen's still to be reviewed; a code's role is about the object, not about the register's case handling.

roles.planned: registered before it exists: projected, provisional or in internal preparation
roles.exists: exists in the world (for an address point: placed, with or without an address)
roles.ended: existed, has ended: demolished, discontinued, historical
roles.cancelled: never came to exist: shelved or deleted before it became valid
roles.case: a state of a case or of the register's handling, not of the object

bbr-livscyklus.note: BBR's Livscyklus mixes the building's stages with the states of building cases (sager); for buildings, units and installations the stages count.

danmarks-adresser-livscyklus-status.note: Not every status applies to every object (see the code list): addresses, house numbers and roads use 1–6; address points 6–9.

without_status.dagi: DAGI 2.0.0 has no status attribute (removed from the general attributes in 2.0.0): a unit exists while its valid time runs.

geotope.title: Geotope

geotope.concept: a land unit that is internally homogeneous in its long-lasting (*permanent*) geoecological conditions — topography, topsoil and near-surface groundwater — and so offers one kind of potential for vegetation; separated from its neighbours by *geotones*, the zones where those conditions change. Defined by function (what it offers plants), not by genesis (how the landform was made) and not by current land use. ([[Data/Inner workings/Publications/christensen-2026|Christensen, Holmes & Nielsen 2026]])
